priorityList: Maintain Sweeping Strikes whenever 2 or more targets are present.
Maintain Rend on all targets, using Thunder Clap to spread it if talented.
Cast Avatar on cooldown, ideally aligned with other major burst windows.
Cast Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) on cooldown to apply the damage taken debuff.
Cast Champion's Spear on cooldown, preferably while the target has the Colossus Smash debuff.
Use Ravager during the Colossus Smash debuff window for maximum impact.
Cast Bladestorm while the Colossus Smash debuff is active to capitalize on Slayer's dominance.
Use Execute whenever a Sudden Death proc occurs.
Cast Cleave as your primary Rage spender in multi-target situations.
Cast Whirlwind if Cleave is on cooldown, especially if you have 3 stacks of Collateral Damage.
During Execute phase (target <35% health), prioritize Execute to build Executioner's Precision stacks.
In Execute phase, cast Mortal Strike once you reach 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision or if Colossus Smash is active.
Use Overpower to generate Rage, avoid capping charges, and trigger Opportunist procs.
Cast Mortal Strike in AoE to maintain Deep Wounds or as a high-priority filler.
Activate offensive Trinkets and Racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) while Colossus Smash is active.
